channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Packer boys crush Winhawks
item.description: Austin defeats Winona 80-54 behind Xzayveun Severin’s six threes and 32 points, moving the Packers to 13-10 overall.

item.title: Top Vendor Management Systems to Reduce Duplicate Vendors and Rework (2026)
item.description: Duplicate vendors rarely start as a “data problem.”

item.title: County commissioners clear the way for rifle use in deer hunting
item.description: Mower County board opts against shotgun-only rule, defaulting to new state law that allows rifles for deer hunting.

item.title: From Chicago’s West Side to Africa, Prexy Nesbitt shares a lifetime of civil rights activism
item.description: Civil rights veteran Prexy Nesbitt retraces his path from Chicago’s West Side to African liberation struggles, reflecting on apartheid, Vietnam War protests and today’s injustices.

item.title: Blue Devil men will open Region Tournament play on Thursday
item.description: No. 5 Riverland men open MCAC Region XIII Tournament Thursday vs Minnesota North Mesabi Range after a 26-2 season, in a bracket that leads to the NJCAA Division III national tournament.

item.title: Margaret Teresa Overlie
item.description: Margaret Teresa Overlie, age 101, of Minneapolis , passed away on February 23rd. Preceded in death by her husband of 66 years, George.

item.title: Rev. John Messenger Swatosh
item.description: Rev. John Messenger Swatosh, age 82, entered eternal rest on February 15, 2026, at 4:26 p.m., surrounded by his loving family.

item.title: Hulne: Rebels and Vikings fought to the finish, now they'll play each other
item.description: After rallying from big deficits at Mayo Civic Center, Southland and Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy girls basketball will face off in the Section 1A semifinals Saturday at 6:30 p.m.

item.title: Minnesota gun bills stall but Annunciation families vow to keep pushing the proposals
item.description: Minnesota assault-weapon, high-capacity magazine bans deadlock in House panel, but Annunciation shooting survivors say they'll keep pressing lawmakers.

item.title: Austin girls knocked out of tournament by Raiders
item.description: No. 6 seed Austin girls see season end with 74-44 Section 1AAA quarterfinal loss at No. 3 Northfield, despite 13 points from Gracie Arndt.
